posts.author: SkyBlue_the_Alicorn
posts.body: Is there a time limit for how long movies can be in RPG Maker VX Ace? I put a test one in and it seemed to suddenly cut back to the game after around a minute. The movie itself was really only 2 seconds over a minute, but I want to have much longer cutscenes. Is this possible, or do all cutscenes have to be a minute or under? Thank you!

posts.author: gstv87
posts.body:
doesn't say anything about time in the help files, only resolution.
probably a codec hiccup?

posts.author: SkyBlue_the_Alicorn
posts.body: That could be, how could I fix that?

posts.author: gstv87
posts.body:
IDK... depends on your conversion.
see if you can add an extra second to the clip on an editor, and convert to at least 5000kbps.

posts.author: SkyBlue_the_Alicorn
posts.body: Ok, I'll give that a try.
